summary: Created SCH-04 test specification and tightened scheduler integration coverage to trace all SCH-04 acceptance criteria. Added tests/specs/SCH-04.md with explicit mapping for activation-time timer creation, ESCALATION append while task remains pending, same-transaction reassignment, cancellation on task completion, and PD-05 duration validation ownership. Updated tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig so TC-SCH-04-01 now asserts the persisted escalation timer fire time is derived from task.created_at plus the configured ISO 8601 duration, while existing TC-SCH-04-02 and TC-SCH-04-03 continue to cover escalation firing/reassignment and pre-fire cancellation behavior.
